title: Smart Parking Camera Vehicle Detection Pipeline Failure
description: Smart Parking intermittently fails to register newly parked vehicles. Video stream feed is operational, but vehicle occupancy events are not published.

evidence.content: ERROR [inference_worker] Frame drop count spiked to 85% in parking-camera-pipeline due to CUDA out-of-memory error in object detection inference model v2.1. Inference queue full (500/500).
Camera Pipeline Diagnostic: Video decoder active at 30 FPS, but frame buffer overflows because object detection GPU memory leak prevents model from processing incoming frames.
